description: Fit one common norovirus dose-response across all four hull classes on the airborne-corrected model (hourly clock, unit-safe reservoir/behaviour/cost parameters, per-partner direct-contact dose, and inhaled-air-volume airborne dose from PR #332), with containment treated as an explicit campaign variable rather than a fixed nuisance. Pathogen biology is identical in every cell: one profile, one dose ladder, applied unchanged to expedition/classic/spirit/mega. What is allowed to differ operationally is quarantine compliance, which is swept as four named response branches on top of the same syndromic surveillance configuration, so a class-dependent compliance result stays visible as an operational parameter and is never absorbed into the dose. The transmission-only branch (none_response: surveillance off AND the escalation ladder unreachable) is run on the same cells as the counterfactual, because the ladder is scored on ground-truth ever-ill and would otherwise confine the ship even with surveillance disabled. Seeding is at constant per-capita prevalence (1/4/7/11 index cases at the expedition rate of 1 per 450 passengers) so that introduction pressure, not complement, is held fixed across hulls; a single-index-case sensitivity arm at dose 6.0 measures how much of any residual hull gradient is seeding rather than transmission. Scored on cumulative reported passenger cases against the VSP class medians and IQRs (expedition 8.56 percent, 4.51-13.60; classic 5.59 percent, 4.46-7.76; spirit 5.64 percent, 4.44-7.90; mega 5.61 percent, 3.40-7.45), with infection attack rate, ever-ill passenger rate, peak prevalence and take-off frequency reported alongside so that dose effects and containment effects remain separable. This is the v2 re-run of common_dose_containment_v1: v1 was executed before the airborne dose correction, under which every occupant inhaled a fixed fraction of the whole zone aerosol mass, so per-capita airborne dose rose with zone occupancy and the required dose rose monotonically with complement. The dose ladder is shifted up by half a rung to 4.5-8.0 because a local three-seed pilot on the corrected model places the expedition crossing near 5.0-5.5 and the classic crossing near 6.0, and the ladder needs headroom above the largest hull. Seeds are 940-949, held out from both the v1 campaign and the pilot.
